name: Placard (Jogos Santa Casa)
verdict: Operated by Santa Casa da Misericordia de Lisboa, which runs Portugal's social games on behalf and on account of the State. Nothing found.
note: Portuguese state-linked fixed-odds sports betting product of Jogos Santa Casa; online licences held by SAS Apostas Sociais, Jogos e Apostas Online, S.A. (SRIJ). Main kit sponsor at Alverca, Moreirense and Vitoria SC in 2026-27. Rating note: Santa Casa runs the social games on behalf and on account of the Portuguese State, but no record of serious abuses by Portugal is recorded, and state ownership alone is not a tier.
